svg.title: RMR control panel wiring, upper deck
svg.text: RMR control panel: upper deck wiring
Upper deck, on the upper plate: drives, logic and field terminals. Sheet 1's circuits on the parts of sheet 3, every wire from terminal to terminal.
X4 to the endstops, a pair each; X5 to the servos;
X6 to the lid (S4 and UV array, S5) and the argon valve
to the operator panel: Mega USB, Pi GPIO to the tower SSRs;
to the spin coater base: J11 (ODrive UART)
X7 to the tower, 1 motor cable
+5.4 V servo, +5 V Pi, +12 V screen
servo PSU +5.4 V to X5 V+
lower ground bar to upper ground bar
F1-3 to the 12 V DC-DC +Vin (screen supply)
screen +12 V: the plug's pigtail, via the lower left grommet
screen 12 V return, isolated: the same pigtail
K2 A1 to X2 3b (coil, node Y)
star S to 0V-S: the Mega's 0 V reference (ADR-0021)
door cable: X2 1 to S2 NC1, via the lower left grommet
door cable: NC1 and S3 (node X) to X2 2
door cable: S3 (node Y) to X2 3
Seen from above, front at the left, so the left wall is at the top. Each part sits where sheet 3
puts it; ducts and channels are drawn wider than scale so that every wire shows: measure from sheet 3.
Terminals are drawn on the face their wires leave from; read the real order off each part.
Since 2026-10-15 the Pi sits at the operator panel on the 5 V PSU and the Mega runs on the Pi's USB:
F1-1, X8 and X2 4-5 are spare (NC2 and the home button are wired at the panel). The ODrive sits in
the spin coater's base. The screen takes 12 V from the isolated DC-DC on F1-3 (ADR-0020).
Gauges (issue #205): mains, the PSU to F3 and S, F3 to K2 and FB1, K2's pole jumper, K2 to FB2, S to
0V-P and the 0V-P link: 12 AWG copper. F2-1 to F2-8 and F2-12 with their 0 V returns, the servo 5.4 V and Pi 5 V
pairs: 14 AWG copper. The F0 rung: 18 AWG UL 1015, 600 V. The screen's 12 V: the plug's 18 AWG
pigtail. Everything else: the 20 AWG on hand, copper-clad aluminum (about 3 A), on fuses of 3 A or less.
PE home runs of the frame, the DIN rails and the TB6600 cases go to the ground bars (sheet 4).
0 V meets PE only at star S, by its one wire to the lower ground bar.
Open: tower common polarity, lid feed, valve coil, servo torque at 5.4 V, J11 logic supply.
The 5 V and servo supplies are DDR-30G-5 converters (ADR-0021); set each one's output on the bench.
Motor cables: shield to the clamp bar; seven leave by the upper left grommet and one by the upper
right one: pick which on the bench. Each TB6600: PUL-, DIR- and ENA- jumpered to COM at the driver.
The tower cable leaves X7 by the upper right grommet, as sheet 3 has it, so it crosses the deck
behind every rail; the upper left grommet, beside X7, would save most of that run.
1 k from 5V to 43 and 100 nF from 40 to GND on the Mega's screw shield.
RMR control panel: upper deck wiring
Sheet 2B (2A: lower deck). Legal 14 x 8.5 in, landscape, 100 %.
Status: design, not yet built or tested.
Circuits: sheet 1. Positions: sheet 3. Frame and PE: sheet 4.
